# Gap Castle

> Gap Castle (Gap Castle Limited) is a Nigerian fintech and registered money lender based in Ikeja, Lagos. Customers use it to pay utility bills, buy airtime and data, renew cable TV, buy exam PINs, pay insurance premiums and access quick loans, earning cashback on payments.

Gap Castle has been incorporated in Nigeria since 2020. It is duly incorporated under the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and registered to carry on money lending, bill payments and other financial services.

## Contact

- Facebook: https://web.facebook.com/gapcastle

## Services

- Airtime and data bundles for MTN, Airtel, Glo and 9mobile
- Electricity bills (prepaid tokens and postpaid) for Nigerian discos
- Cable TV subscriptions (DStv, GOtv, Startimes)
- Internet subscriptions (Spectranet, Smile)
- Education PINs (WAEC, JAMB, NECO)
- Insurance premiums, water and gas bills, collections and levies
- Quick loans with no collateral
